messages:
ana: tiny PR to fix an example link in the SDK migration guide (JS snippet) — i noticed we still point to `@redwood/sdk-old` in one spot. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2412. target merge slot today.

jon: can you paste the file + line? i can patch quickly.

ana: file: docs/guides/migration-js.md line ~72. old import: `import { Client } from '@redwood/sdk-old'` should be `import { Client } from '@redwood/sdk'`.

ana: also, the Netlify preview shows linkcheck warnings for external links (auth blog post)  it times out occasionally.

ci-bot: CI started for PR #2412  checks: lint, mkdocs-build, linkcheck. linkcheck: 1 warning for https://blog.external.example/auth (timeout).

jon: we usually mark flaky external link as allowance in linkcheck config, but for a docs PR this small we can add `||` to the markdown to make it non-checkable: `[auth blog](https://blog.external.example/auth){.nochek}` — or update our linkcheck pattern.

devex: FYI do not invent custom attributes for standard markdown unless we have a preprocess hook. better to add the external link to `mkdocs.yml` exclude list under `link-checker: exclude:`. send a follow-up PR for that if needed.

ana: patched import and pushed. linkcheck still warns in this run but i can open a follow-up to add the external to exclude list.

netlify-bot: Preview: https://preview.netlify.app/redwood-docs/PR-2412  build passed.

ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #2412.

jon: merged in slot, thanks. small PRs like this are great for rapid turn.

ana: thanks everyone :)
